title: The Healing Wizard in Another World
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: University student Shiki Satou wakes up in a dungeon town in another world with Healing Magic and an Appraisal skill. Fired from a clinic for sexually harassing patients in exchange for healing, he becomes a dungeon adventurer and meets Yuel, a young, maimed slave girl, the start of a harem.
life_message: Power and luck in a new world let a man build the companionship and pleasure he wants.
